whatItDoes: Projects your retirement balance by compounding current savings together with monthly contributions over your chosen number of years to retirement.
whyItExists: The biggest influence on retirement readiness is time in the market plus consistent saving. Showing the projected balance and the contribution-growth split makes it easy to see how much your money does for you.
whoShouldUse: Anyone building a retirement nest egg who wants a realistic projection and a view of how monthly contributions and returns interact.
useCases: Project a 401(k) or IRA balance at retirement
See the impact of raising monthly contributions
Estimate the total you'll actually contribute
instructions: Enter your current retirement savings balance
Enter an expected annual return as a percent
Read the projected balance, contributions, and growth
bestPractices: Use a conservative return you're comfortable assuming
Re-run as your income and contributions grow
Include employer matching if you have it
Check the growth vs. contributions split to see compounding's effect
commonMistakes: Starting contributions at the top of your budget with no buffer
Ignoring taxes and inflation in the real value
faq: Does this include taxes and inflation? — No, it is a nominal pre-tax projection.
What return should I use? — A common assumption is 6-8%, but use your own planning number.
Is employer matching included? — Only if you add it to the monthly contribution.
Is my data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.
